usdRate.sourceName: DGII table of BCRD reference exchange rates 2026 (US dollar)
usdRate.note: BCRD reference rate, pesos per US dollar, on 30 October 2026 as published by the tax authority (October 2026 average 60.72).

inflation_cpi.sourceName: elDinero, reporting the Banco Central de la República Dominicana CPI release
inflation_cpi.note: Secondary source (BCRD press release reported by elDinero, 13 October 2026): CPI rose 5.12% year on year in September 2026 (core 4.61%), down from a 5.67% peak in June.

inflation_projection.sourceName: BCRD inflation target 4% plus or minus 1 point; CPI 5.1-5.7% in mid-2026
inflation_projection.note: We plan with the central bank's 4% target, which inflation has mostly been near over the past decade, although 2026 readings run above it.

policy_rate.sourceName: elDinero, reporting the BCRD monetary policy decision of September 2026
policy_rate.note: Secondary source: the BCRD raised its policy rate (TPM) by 25 basis points to 5.50% at its September 2026 meeting (1-day repo facility 6.00%, overnight deposits 4.75%); the October 2026 decision could not be confirmed.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Banco Central de la República Dominicana: tasas de interés pasivas de los bancos múltiples (promedio ponderado)
savings_account_rate.note: Weighted average rate on savings deposits at multiple banks, average of 1-29 October 2026 (preliminary).

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Banco Central de la República Dominicana: tasas de interés pasivas de los bancos múltiples (promedio ponderado)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Certificates and time deposits of 61-90 days, weighted average at multiple banks, 1-29 October 2026 (preliminary); 0-30 days 7.68%, 91-180 days 7.22%.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Banco Central de la República Dominicana: tasas de interés pasivas de los bancos múltiples (promedio ponderado)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Certificates and time deposits of 181-360 days, weighted average at multiple banks, 1-29 October 2026 (preliminary); 361 days-2 years 6.28%.

dps_rate.note: The BCRD rate tables have no series for monthly recurring (programmed) savings; no official rate found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Banco Central de la República Dominicana: tasas de interés pasivas de los bancos múltiples (promedio ponderado)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Weighted average rate on financial certificates and time deposits in pesos at multiple banks, 1-29 October 2026 (preliminary); it fell from about 9.6% in mid-2025.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate sold directly to individuals was found; Ministry of Finance peso bonds reach individuals through the stock market after auction.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No 91-day treasury bill yield found. The nearest short-term figure: BCRD Letras auction of 29 October 2026 awarded only the 161-day bill, at a weighted average yield of 8.32% (cdn.bancentral.gov.do Letras_bc_resultados.pdf).

tbond_5y_rate.note: Ministry of Finance (Crédito Público) auction results could not be opened (HTTP 403); no 5-year peso bond yield found.

tbond_10y_rate.note: Ministry of Finance (Crédito Público) auction results could not be opened (HTTP 403); no 10-year peso bond yield found.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: Dirección General de Impuestos Internos (DGII), technical consultation on interest withholding (Código Tributario art. 306 bis)
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest paid to resident individuals is subject to a 10% income-tax withholding, a final payment or an advance depending on the taxpayer's return. (PwC Tax Summaries describes such interest as exempt; we follow the tax authority.)

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate for individuals exists to tax; interest on other instruments paid to individuals falls under the 10% withholding of art. 306 bis.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: elDinero: Fondo de Contingencia (Ley Monetaria y Financiera 183-02, art. 64)
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Secondary source: the BCRD contingency fund guarantees each depositor up to RD$1,860,000 if a financial institution is liquidated.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap found (interest rates are freely set under Ley 183-02) and the BCRD lending-rate tables do not report a credit card rate.

equity_return_low.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (peso per dollar); BCRD deposit rates
equity_return_low.note: Low case: weak global equities in dollars plus little peso depreciation.

equity_return_base.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (peso per dollar); BCRD deposit rates (181-360 days 6.52%, 5.9% after 10% tax)
equity_return_base.note: The local stock market trades almost no shares, so we use a global equity index of about 7% a year in dollars plus about 2% yearly peso depreciation, kept under the after-tax 1-year deposit rate plus 4 points.

equity_return_high.note: High case: strong global equities and faster peso depreciation.

gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with slight peso depreciation.

gold_return_base.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (peso per dollar; about 46 in 2015 and 62 in 2025)
gold_return_base.note: Dollar gold trend of about 4.5% a year plus about 2% yearly peso depreciation.

gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold and faster peso depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Banco Central de la República Dominicana: tasas de interés pasivas de los bancos múltiples (promedio ponderado)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: term deposits at about 5.5-6% less the 10% withholding, allowing for rates falling further.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Banco Central de la República Dominicana: tasas de interés pasivas de los bancos múltiples (promedio ponderado)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: 1-year deposits at 6.5% (5.9% after tax) and BCRD bills at about 8% (7.5% after tax).

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: central bank and government paper at about 8.3% less the 10% withholding.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio found from the Superintendencia de Seguros.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life is sold, but no published per-1,000 premium rates by age from the regulator or another public source were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No public premium table for private health insurance by age was found.

goal_inflation_health.note: Headline CPI runs at about 5%; private clinic and medicine costs usually rise faster, so we plan with 6%.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: elDinero (BCRD CPI release, September 2026): education prices up 1.85% in September alone on private-school fees
goal_inflation_education.note: Private school fees push education prices above headline, so we plan with 6%.

life_expectancy.note: UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 74.1 for 2026 (men 70.9, women 77.4).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium-variant projections for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 12.48 (2025, World Bank), 18.7 (2040) and 31.1 (2065, populationpyramid.net/dominican-republic/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Superintendencia de Pensiones (SIPEN), Resolución 72-03 on contributory pension benefits (Ley 87-01)
retirement_age_default.note: Old-age pension from age 60 with at least 360 monthly contributions; a pension from 55 is possible if the individual account can fund it. Same for men and women. The resolution dates from 2003 and is still the rule we found.

retirement_age_government.note: Public employees are covered by the same Ley 87-01 contributory system (60 with 360 contributions); members of the old civil-service scheme (Ley 379) aged up to 45 when the system began moved over with a recognition bond. Source dates from 2003.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Banco Central de la República Dominicana: tasas de interés pasivas de los bancos múltiples (promedio ponderado)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: short deposits after the 10% withholding, with rates easing.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Banco Central de la República Dominicana: tasas de interés pasivas de los bancos múltiples (promedio ponderado)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case below the after-tax 1-year deposit rate of about 5.9% (6.52% less 10%).

retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of central bank and government paper at about 8% less tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Banco Central de la República Dominicana: tasas de interés pasivas de los bancos múltiples (promedio ponderado)
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix of deposits and global equities.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Banco Central de la República Dominicana: tasas de interés pasivas de los bancos múltiples (promedio ponderado)
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: about half global equities at 9% in pesos and half fixed income at 6%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Banco Central de la República Dominicana: tasas de interés pasivas de los bancos múltiples (promedio ponderado)
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case with strong equities and higher local rates.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: elDinero: solidarity pensions of the subsidised regime (Sistema Dominicano de Seguridad Social)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Secondary source: each solidarity pension pays RD$6,000 a month plus a Christmas payment; granted by decree in limited batches (57,242 beneficiaries by September 2025).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: elDinero: CNSS rules for solidarity pensions
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: People over 60 whose income is below half the national minimum wage, after a poverty assessment (SIUBEN); also people with disabilities and some single mothers.

gratuity_rule.sourceName: Revista Mercado: auxilio de cesantía under art. 80 of the Labour Code (Ley 16-92)
gratuity_rule.note: Secondary source: severance (cesantía) when the employer ends the contract without cause: 21 days' ordinary wage per year for 1-5 years of service and 23 days per year after more than 5 years (shorter scales under 1 year); daily wage = monthly wage / 23.83. Not paid on resignation.

public_pension_scheme.note: Mandatory individual-account (AFP) system under Ley 87-01 for private and public employees: employee 2.87% plus employer 7.10% of salary (PwC Tax Summaries, 2026); old-age pension from 60 with 360 contributions, paid as programmed withdrawal or annuity; no automatic inflation indexing described in the sources read.

savings_account.note: Peso savings accounts pay well under 1% a year on average.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring-deposit product with a published rate was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate is sold directly to individuals; Ministry of Finance peso bonds can be bought on the stock market through brokers.

tbill_91d.localNameEn: Central bank bills (terms under one year)
tbill_91d.note: Auctioned by the BCRD; terms vary (161-308 days in the October 2026 auction) rather than a fixed 91 days.

tbond_5y.note: Auctioned by the Dirección General de Crédito Público; individuals buy on the secondary market.

tbond_10y.note: Auctioned by the Dirección General de Crédito Público; individuals buy on the secondary market.

equity_fund.note: Local investment funds supervised by the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores invest mainly in fixed income; no diversified local equity index fund was found.

gold.note: Gold can be bought legally from jewellers and dealers.

centralBank.name: Banco Central de la República Dominicana

insuranceComplaints.name: Superintendencia de Seguros (policyholder complaints)
insuranceComplaints.note: No separate insurance ombudsman; the Superintendencia handles complaints.

pensionScheme.name: Sistema Dominicano de Pensiones (Ley 87-01), supervised by the Superintendencia de Pensiones (SIPEN)

oldAgeAllowance.name: Pensiones solidarias del Régimen Subsidiado, Consejo Nacional de Seguridad Social

depositInsurance.name: Fondo de Contingencia, Banco Central de la República Dominicana
depositInsurance.note: Guarantee set by Ley Monetaria y Financiera 183-02, art. 64.
